Title: Power BI Embedded API for programmatic control of visual headers

Body.Content:
Visual headers contain the action bar of a visual, which displays all the actions a user can take—like entering focus mode, drilling down, or exporting data. Power BI Embedded now supports the ability for you to limit user access to those actions programmatically through an API.

Learn more about how to hide the visual header by using the API.
